name: memora-sprite
description: Memora 精灵桌面伴侣——能自我进化的本地 AI Agent

scripts.build:electron: npm run check-ipc && npm run generate-icons && node --input-type=module -e "import{rmSync}from'node:fs';rmSync('dist-electron',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node scripts/build-preload.mjs && node scripts/copy-renderer.mjs
scripts.start:electron: chcp 65001 >nul && set NODE_ENV=production&& npm run build:electron && set NODE_ENV=production&& electron ./dist-electron/electron/main.js
scripts.dev:electron: chcp 65001 >nul && set NODE_ENV=development&& npm run build:electron && node scripts/dev-watch.mjs
scripts.dev:web: set NODE_ENV=development&& npm run build:electron && tsx src/web/server.ts
scripts.start:web: set NODE_ENV=production&& npm run build:web && node dist-web/web/server.js
scripts.check-configs: npm run check-ipc && npm run check-cli-keys
scripts.package:win: npm run build:electron && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs --win --x64
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:electron && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs --mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:electron && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs --linux
scripts.package:all: npm run build:electron && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs --win --mac --linux
